title: JUKI LK-1903B-SS301
subtitle: Computer-Controlled High-Speed Lockstitch Button Sewing Machine

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The JUKI LK-1903B-SS301 is a computer-controlled, high-speed lockstitch button-sewing machine. It automatically positions and sews buttons onto garments using a digital X-Y feed mechanism, eliminating manual button placement and producing consistent, secure stitches at high production rates.
applications: Attaching flat buttons on shirt fronts, cuffs, and collars
Sewing buttons on jeans, trousers, and workwear
High-volume button attachment in industrial garment production
Pattern shirts, blouses, and uniforms requiring consistent button placement
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing (shirts, trousers, jeans, uniforms), workwear production, mass-production apparel assembly lines

overviewDescription: The JUKI LK-1903B-SS301 is a computer-controlled lockstitch button sewer belonging to the JUKI LK-1900B button-sewing series. The SS301 suffix indicates it accepts buttons sized φ8–φ20 mm (the SS302 variant accepts φ10–φ20 mm). It uses a digital X-Y feed to position each button automatically under the needle, then sews a programmed stitch pattern (typically a cross / T / parallel stitch) and auto-trims the threads. The machine is widely deployed on shirt and trouser production lines because of its high speed and consistent stitch quality.

• SS301 vs SS302 differ only in the button-size range covered by the work clamp; mechanical / electronic components are otherwise identical.
